context:
You asked, 14:45 CDT: confirm we understood you before we act. Our reading of your 12:45 CDT note ('ideally merging across all my repos would have just the same required checks and nothing more or less'): every repo you own requires the same set of checks before a merge to main. Today degen and ios-adblock require one rollup check, all-jobs-passed, that passes only when every other job passed. So q_max would require that same one check, not its four separate ones (gate, tiers, specimen, repo-checks); those four still run, inside the rollup. The coordinator pauses the q_max lane until you confirm.

Why it matters: q_max's main has no branch protection today (GitHub answers 404), so a red PR can merge.
ref: r1 (compliance visit, q_max); like your item 71 a for degen
steps: Reply with a note: 'yes' if that is what you meant, or say what you meant instead. Then Mark done.
title: Protect q_max's main: did we read your note right?
why: Without it, nothing stops a red PR from merging into q_max's main.
